description:
The /fly HUD speed readout displays 'NaN km/s' for outer-planet missions (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Ceres) once the spacecraft passes ~2.5 AU from the Sun — which happens rapidly on every outer-system flight.

Expected: The HUD speed readout should show a physically plausible heliocentric speed in km/s for any destination. For an Earth→Jupiter transfer, the speed at Jupiter distance should be ~13 km/s (Jupiter's orbital speed) plus hyperbolic excess.

Acceptance criteria:
- The HUD speed readout on /fly must display a finite numeric km/s value (not NaN) for every mission destination, including Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, and Ceres. [code-invariant: Line 6783 renders `heliocentricKms.toFixed(2)`, which produces 'NaN km/s' when heliocentricKms is NaN. NaN in a user-facing HUD is a crash signal.]
- The displayed speed must be computed from a transfer semi-major axis derived from the actual Earth-to-destination Hohmann transfer (R_EARTH_AU + destA) / 2, not the Earth→Mars value (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU) / 2 ≈ 1.262 AU. [spec: src/routes/fly/+page.svelte line 952: the second argument to flyHeliocentricSpeed is `(R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU) / 2` for all non-Moon missions. The function doc in src/lib/orbital/fly-physics.ts line 32-36 documents aTransferAu as 'transfer-ellipse semi-major axis (AU). For an Earth→Mars Hohmann a ≈ 1.262' — the hardcoded value is Earth→Mars only.]
- The speed readout must remain finite throughout the entire simulated trajectory, from launch through cruise through arrival. [code-invariant: Line 6783 renders `heliocentricKms.toFixed(2)`. toFixed produces 'NaN' when the value is NaN. The derivation feeds into the rendering path — NaN propagates to the user.]

Domain facts:
- Jupiter semi-major axis ≈ 5.2 AU; Earth→Jupiter Hohmann a ≈ (1 + 5.2)/2 = 3.1 AU
- Saturn semi-major axis ≈ 9.5 AU; Earth→Saturn Hohmann a ≈ 5.25 AU
- Uranus semi-major axis ≈ 19.2 AU; Earth→Uranus Hohmann a ≈ 10.1 AU
- Neptune semi-major axis ≈ 30.1 AU; Earth→Neptune Hohmann a ≈ 15.55 AU
- Pluto semi-major axis ≈ 39.5 AU; Earth→Pluto Hohmann a ≈ 20.25 AU
- Ceres semi-major axis ≈ 2.77 AU; Earth→Ceres Hohmann a ≈ 1.885 AU

Target: src/routes/fly/+page.svelte — heliocentricKms $derived expression (around line 952)
Do NOT change The outboundArc() and transferEllipse() functions in src/lib/orbital/mission-arc.ts already handle destination-specific semi-major axes correctly — they accept a destA parameter (defaulting to R_MARS_AU) or compute a from r1+r2. Do NOT touch mission-arc.ts. The fix is entirely in the +page.svelte call site: replace the hardcoded (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU) / 2 with a destination-dependent value derived from the mission's dest field. Use DESTINATIONS from $lib/lambert-grid.constants to look up the destination's semi-major axis (DESTINATIONS[mission.dest]?.a), then compute (R_EARTH_AU + destA) / 2. The DESTINATIONS map is already imported and used by the page via destinationPos(). — it is not the owner of this symptom.
